summary:
[  edit  ]
The  Folder   DAT  lists the files and subfolders found in a file system folder and monitors any changes.
For each item found, a row is created in the table with optional columns for the following information:
Name
Base Name
Extension
Type
Size
Depth
Folder
Path
Relative  Path
Date Created
Date Modified
Date Accessed
folderDAT_Class
Contents
1   Summary
2   Parameters - Folder Page
3   Parameters - Columns Page
4   Parameters - Common Page
5   Info CHOP Channels
5.1   Common DAT Info Channels
5.2   Common Operator Info Channels

parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: When off, the  DAT  outputs a single-row table with only the headings, useful when dormant or when sending the  DAT  to a  Replicator COMP .

parameters.label: Root   Folder
parameters.name: rootfolder
parameters.description: The folder in the filesystem whose contents will be displayed in the  DAT  list.

parameters.label: Refresh
parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: When on, it monitors the specified folder(s) of the filesystem.

parameters.label: Refresh  Pulse
parameters.name: refreshpulse
parameters.description: The pulse button reads the folder contents once.

parameters.label: Asynchronous Update
parameters.name: async
parameters.description: When on, the update happens asynchronously from the main thread so it doesn't make TouchDesigner drop frames or pause. As a result, the  Folder   DAT  way not update its data within the next frame after the change on disk.

parameters.label: Name Format
parameters.name: nameformat
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select whether to include the filename extension or not.

parameters.label: Date Format
parameters.name: dateformat
parameters.description: ⊞  - The format used to display the item's dates in the table.

parameters.label: Standard
parameters.name: std
parameters.description: A standard date format.

parameters.label: Epoch
parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: A reference date format.

parameters.label: Type
parameters.name: type
parameters.description: ⊞  - The types of contents to display.

parameters.label: Files
parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Include files.

parameters.label: Folders
parameters.name: folders
parameters.description: Include folders.

parameters.label: Files and Folders
parameters.name: filesandfolders
parameters.description: Include both files and folders.

parameters.label: Folders
parameters.name: folders
parameters.description: Use  Pattern Matching  to specify which folders are included.  Matches the folder path.  Delimiters used are spaces and commas.  To match spaces, enclose the entire search term in double quotes.

parameters.label: Names
parameters.name: names
parameters.description: Use  Pattern Matching  to specify which names are included.  Delimiters used are spaces and commas.  To match spaces, enclose the entire search term in double quotes.

parameters.label: All  Extensions
parameters.name: allextensions
parameters.description: Includes all file extensions.

parameters.label: Image  Extensions
parameters.name: imageextensions
parameters.description: Includes image contents that are supported by TouchDesigner. See supported  File Types .

parameters.label: Movie  Extensions
parameters.name: movieextensions
parameters.description: Includes movie contents that are supported by TouchDesigner. See supported  File Types .

parameters.label: Audio  Extensions
parameters.name: audioextensions
parameters.description: Includes audio contents that are supported by TouchDesigner. See supported  File Types .

parameters.label: Extensions
parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description: Use  Pattern Matching  to specify which extensions are included.  Extensions  listed here should not include the period. E.g *txt, not *.txt.

parameters.label: Include Subfolders
parameters.name: subfolders
parameters.description: Includes the subfolders from the root folder specified.

parameters.label: Minumum Depth
parameters.name: mindepth
parameters.description: Set a minmum depth for the subfolders the  Folder   DAT  should recursively search through.

parameters.label: Limit Depth
parameters.name: limitdepth
parameters.description: Turns on the Maximum Depth parameter to limit searching through subfolders. Turning this toggle off will search through all subtrees.

parameters.label: Maximum Depth
parameters.name: maxdepth
parameters.description: Set the maximum depth for the subfolders the  Folder   DAT  should recursively search through.

parameters.label: Name
parameters.name: namecol
parameters.description: The name of the folder or file. In the case of a file this includes the extension. ie.  myfile.txt

parameters.label: Base Name
parameters.name: basenamecol
parameters.description: The name of the folder or file. In the case of a file this form does not includes the extension. ie.  myfile

parameters.label: Extension
parameters.name: extensioncol
parameters.description: The file extension of the file, blank for folders. ie.  txt

parameters.label: Type
parameters.name: typecol
parameters.description: The type of file as reported by the operating system.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.name: sizecol
parameters.description: The size of the file in Bytes. Folders do not report any size.

parameters.label: Depth
parameters.name: depthcol
parameters.description: How many folders deep the item is found from the  Root   Folder . Items on the  Root   Folder  level have a depth of 0.

parameters.label: Folder
parameters.name: foldercol
parameters.description: The path of the folder, or in the case of a file, the path of the folder the file is found in.

parameters.label: Path
parameters.name: pathcol
parameters.description: The full path to the folder or file.

parameters.label: Relative  Path
parameters.name: relpathcol
parameters.description: The relative path to the folder or file from the  Root   Folder .

parameters.label: Date Created
parameters.name: datecreatedcol
parameters.description: The date of creation.

parameters.label: Date Modified
parameters.name: datemodifiedcol
parameters.description: The date of most recent modification.

parameters.label: Date Accessed
parameters.name: dateaccessedcol
parameters.description: The date of most recent access or opening.

parameters.label: Language
parameters.name: language
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how the  DAT  decides which script language to operate on.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs script language.

parameters.label: Node
parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses it's own script language.

parameters.label: Edit/View Extension
parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select the file extension this  DAT  should expose to external editors.

parameters.label: dat
parameters.name: dat
parameters.description: various common file extensions.

parameters.label: From Language
parameters.name: language
parameters.description: pick extension from DATs script language.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: Specify a custom extension.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: customext
parameters.description: Specifiy the custom extension.

parameters.label: Word Wrap
parameters.name: wordwrap
parameters.description: ⊞  - Enable Word Wrap for Node Display.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs setting.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Turn on Word Wrap.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: Turn off Word Wrap.

parameters.label: num_rows
parameters.description: Number of rows in this  DAT .

parameters.label: num_cols
parameters.description: Number of columns in this  DAT .

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: An  Operator Family  that manipulates text strings: multi
parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: TouchDesigner is a hierarchy of components. "root" is the top
parameters.description: most network in the hierarchy. The  Network Path  or Path for root is simply  / . A typical path is  /project1/moviein1 .

parameters.label: To "pulse" a parameter is to send it a signal from (1) an  exported  CHOP channel or (2) a python command or (3) a mouse click that causes a new action to occur immediately. A pulse via python is via the  .pulse()  function on a pulse
parameters.description: type parameter, such as Reset parameter in a  Speed CHOP . A pulse from a CHOP is typically a 0 to 1 to 0 signal in an exported channel.
